inputs.detail: Stakeholder requests Foundry-equivalent developer workflows on Scaleway
Supplied Foundry sidebar separates resources and developer actions; not approved Scaleway sources
Provider docs confirm inference/deployment/HTTP hosting/monitoring building blocks, not tested contracts
Strands Python SDK selected by stakeholder on 2026-10-20; Scaleway integration and serverless application hosting remain unverified
Cross-tool friction and time savings are unmeasured

userValues.currentAlternative: Console playground plus SDK/scripts and separate tools
userValues.valueHypothesis: Reduce total useful-task effort; not measured
userValues.costOfFailure: Secret leakage, wasted spend or incorrect application behavior
userValues.successCriterion: Complete supported streaming test and run exported example without secret leakage

userValues.goal: Control deployment and tool effects with evidence
userValues.currentAlternative: Manual IAM, deployment commands and dashboards
userValues.valueHypothesis: Reduce ambiguous effects and cleanup effort; not measured
userValues.costOfFailure: Unauthorized exposure, costs and orphaned resources

questions.prompt: What complete first task creates useful portable output?
questions.answer: SC1 from connection to exported example; benefit tested in EXP1

questions.prompt: What does Scaleway supply versus what must we own?
questions.answer: Scaleway supplies documented cloud building blocks; selected Strands Python provides agent orchestration inside our policy/event wrapper. Compatibility and hosting require EXP2/EXP3.

decisions.detail: Prioritize portable model experiment MVP, not complete Foundry menu parity
decisions.productImpact: Test narrow useful value before maintaining broad agent platform
decisions.uxImpact: Connect through exported runnable example with complete recovery
decisions.uiImpact: Resources/actions trees and focused experiment editor; no placeholder menus

decisions.detail: Use stakeholder-selected Strands Python for local agents; separate model deployment from agent runtime and hosting
decisions.productImpact: Avoid promises of unverified managed agent services
decisions.uxImpact: Explicit tool mandates, reviewed deployment and cleanup
decisions.uiImpact: Distinct deployment targets and status/effect labels
